title: Form A - Advanced grammar
instructions: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word(s) in brackets, or one missing word.

items.q: If she ______ (not / lend) me the money last year, I would still be paying off my debts now.
items.why: Mixed conditional: past condition -> present result.

items.q: Not once ______ (she / complain) about the workload during the whole project.
items.why: Negative adverbial at the start -> inversion.

items.q: It's about time the council ______ (repair) this road.
He ______ (be) at the gym now - he never trains on Sundays.
What surprised me most ______ how calm everyone was.
______ (not / receive) a reply, I called them again.
The ship is thought ______ (sink) in the 17th century.
I'd rather we ______ (not / discuss) this in front of the clients.
______ you require further assistance, please contact reception.
You ______ (bring) your umbrella - it didn't rain, and you carried it around all day for nothing.
